{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0666","text":"Subject: Lindqvist stakeholder review!! Thursday 2:00-2:30

HELLO wonderful people!!

I am SO excited to get all 16 of us in one room (and on the screen!) this Thursday, 2:00-2:30, Conference Room B plus the video link below. This is the one we've all been building toward on the Lindqvist contract, and I could not be more pumped!

The Lindqvist side will be joining for the full half hour, so this is our one shot with them before their board meets Monday. Whatever we walk out of that room with is what goes in front of them. No pressure (okay, a little pressure!!).

A few things so we hit the ground running:
- Priya Haddad, please bring the three rate scenarios you modeled. They'll want to pick one live, I'm sure of it!
* Jamal Dube and Emeka Kariuki: the lane capacity numbers for Q3, with the trade-offs on the Northern routes
- Beth Ekwueme - your penalty clause redlines!! They've already flagged two of them
  • Imani Eriksen, warehouse staffing, especially if the volume goes the way they hinted
-Thandi Petrakis, you're our closer as always, so please be ready to say yes or no on the term length right there in the room

Everyone else, please come with your questions and your objections. Better we hear them Thursday than after anything is signed!

I've attached the latest deck and the redlined draft. Please PLEASE skim them beforehand so we aren't reading slides at each other.

This is going to be amazing, team. Cedarfield Freight is about to have a very good week!!

Cheers,
Ada

Description:
Since the last two threads on this didn't land anywhere and the comment chain on the Harborwood doc is now longer than the doc itself, I've booked an hour. In person if at all possible, please. Calendars say everyone's free, so I'm assuming nobody will need to drop at 1:30 this time.

A few things before we meet:

Wes and Hector, I know you both feel strongly. I'd genuinely appreciate hearing it from you directly in the room rather than reading about it in a reply-all afterward.

Aisha, the validation timeline you shared assumes the cleanroom is ready in August. If that's no longer true, it would be great to know Thursday and not in September.

Gemma, could you bring the updated cost comparison? The version from April is the one people keep quoting, and it's out of date.

Bianca, you'll be the one living with whatever comes out of this, so please don't be polite about it.

I'm not circulating a proposal ahead of time. Every time I've done that, the conversation has turned into a debate about my wording. We'll work from the doc as it stands.

I'd really like to leave with a direction we can all live with, even if not everyone loves it. If we can't get there in an hour, then that tells us something too.

Thanks,
Dana

Millwood Therapeutics · Reminder: 30 minutes before"}]}
